working_features: Runs in a REPL loop accepting commands
Generates a random password of configurable length (default 16 characters)
User can set length with a 'length' command followed by a number
User can toggle character sets on/off: uppercase, lowercase, digits, symbols
Generates passwords using only the currently enabled character sets
Displays a strength rating for each generated password (weak, medium, strong, very strong)
User can generate multiple passwords at once with a 'generate N' command
Shows the current configuration when user types 'config'
Refuses to generate if all character sets are disabled with an error message
User can exclude ambiguous characters (0/O, 1/l/I) with a toggle command
User can type 'quit' or 'exit' to stop the program
Supports passphrase generation with configurable word count and strength rating
